main_text.head: Textus VI.
main_text.p: Sunt seductores alii, versi-pelles quidam Genii, ad fallaciam & technas nati: Hi non in cute substitêre, quo-modo Sensus; sed percolati, & medullam subeuntes, ad Animum penetrarunt: His utitur Animus, his ut charissi-mis convictoribus, totum se credidit:his non ducitur jam; sed agitur, trahitur,raptatur: hos necessarios ei, hos ei dominos fecit longafamiliaritas.Maximè vero quorundam Geniorum.
main_text.head: Paraphrasis.
main_text.p: Sunt igitur præter Sensus, seductores alii, iique spiritus, instinctus, Genii, majoris longè, quam Sensus nostri fallaciæ: Cumque

page.notes: The marginal note on the right reads "Maximè vero quorundam Geniorum." The word "Sunt" in the first line and the "que" line at the foot are as printed. Left margin fragments are from the facing page and are not transcribed. The catchword line "que" is set at the right below the paragraph and is treated as text.
